body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Automated Test Report and Evidence Generator, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Evidence collection: results, logs, calibrations, revisions). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Evidence collection: results, logs, calibrations, revisions and Hash-chained, timestamped, signed packages. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Test results comparison and reporting tool) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
capabilities: Evidence collection: results, logs, calibrations, revisions
